nom: ANUA PDRN Collagen Melting Patch For Glass Skin

avis.titre: Must have for 40+ galsMust have for 40+ gals
avis.texte: I’m 40 and always looking for hydrating, glass, giving skin care. I found this through an influencer on Instagram who geared all of her skin care for 40 up, and I have to say this has been one of my favorite products. I pair it with there hyaluronic spray, and also the cream when you read some of the reviews, people talk about the difficulty of using it, but you just have to read the instructions in the pink is just the outer packaging and the melting is the actual mask. It melts right into your skin and your skin feels great and then I massage it in afterwards. this is a must have for me and I use it twice a week because I do feel like it is kind of expensive to use it more often than that. I do wish that I could get it in larger packages.

I have been using all of ANUA's PDRN line for the past couple months. I have been getting compliments from people left and right. Even had a co-worker I hadn't seen in a couple weeks walking into my office and they demanded to know why and how I looked younger. My skin is smooth and soft. It has a glow to it that it never had before. The results aren't immediate but worth the wait.

avis.titre: So far so good, but pretty pricey
avis.texte: So far I’m giving these 4 stars because I do so an immediate glow and smoothing of fine lines with two days of use. I got these patches, the neck ones (which can also be used on the forehead) and the spray. There is kind of a learning curve to these. You need to make sure your skin and fingers are completely dry. I also leave the mesh on until after spraying and after they have dissolved because pulling off the mesh before spraying seems to lift the melting patch portion easily and causing tears when trying to reposition. With anything I think consistency is key with this and because these patches are quite pricy ($15 for 4 uses is kind of bonkers) doing them every day is not financially sustainable. I am purchasing some more, as well as an 8 pack of the neck patches (so I can treat my forehead AND neck), but I’ll be limiting use of the patches to every other day and using the spray and my other skincare (some of which are other PDRN products) in between. I’ll update my review after more consistent use, but I gotta say that my skin is looking plump, moisturized and smoother the last two days.

avis.titre: Love these, but make sure to buy the spray too.
avis.texte: I love these patches so much. I used about once a week. I like wearing them before applying my makeup, or I don’t even add makeup expert for my mascara. This patch is to be used with the accompanying Anna spray. The spray is very hysdrating and gives you an instant shimmery glow. I also love using the spray alone. But since using the patches, I have noticed a lessening of the depth of my wrinkles. I’m a 39 yo female with olive skin. I can definitely see a difference. I’ll add a picture next time I use them .

I have used Clinique and Shiseido products for over 30 years now, but my Daughter (23 y/o) introduced me to Anua produts about 3 years ago. They are absolutely wonderful and they are soo much more affordable. These collagen masks leave a beautiful glass appearance on the skin and it just melts right into your cheek, with the usage of their PDRN Hydrating Capsule Mist spray. It feels like a heavenly drink for your face! I now use their cleansing foam, their toners, their mist spray, their eye revitalizing cream, their daily moisturizing cream, sunscreen, and their gua sha cream. This line is amazing! I would recommend it to anyone wanting a more youthful, moist, and glassy looking appearance. For the price, it doesn't hurt to try them all.
Very good product I love it makes my skin tight and it gives me glow after that. I really like it. I will keep buying this. It’s a little bit pricey but that’s fine.

avis.titre: Did not get the results I was hoping for
avis.texte: I was unable to use these on my skin. I would peel one off, and it would dissolve in my hand before I could make it to my face. What I was able to put on my skin didn't feel hydrated or moisturized at all. I love Anua but not this item. I will not be repurchasing again.

I have only used once so far and did not notice any change yet. My face was sticky where I had applied the patch. You definitely need to make sure your hands are dry before using. Half of one patch stuck to my finger.

If I could give this product zero stars, I would. These so-called collagen patches are a complete scam. They do not work as advertised. Instead of melting into the skin, they are just a wet mesh that has to be peeled off. There is absolutely no “glass skin” effect, no noticeable hydration, no glow, and no improvement whatsoever. My skin looked exactly the same after using them. The product does not match the description, and the claims are misleading. There is no evidence of any collagen benefit at all. I want my money back for this disappointing product. I would not recommend these patches to anyone. Save your money and buy something that actually works. The first photo is before using the patches, and the second is after. If anyone can see any difference, please let me know. I certainly can’t.
I had favourable comments just the day after using this product.. so I guess it’s working. Easy to apply and very convenient. No mess

avis.auteur: la mascarilla que cumple todas las expec
avis.texte: I really liked these patches! They’re easy to use and my favorite part is how my skin looks afterward. My skin feels soft and hydrated, but what really stood out to me was the glow. It gives my skin that fresh, healthy-looking finish that I love, especially when my face is looking a little dull. I’ve been enjoying adding these to my skincare routine and I would definitely use them again.
These came in two dry sheets that did not melt at all. I prepped skin with mist and sprayed a heavy coat but nothing worked. They did not stick to skin or deposit any product. Absolutely useless!

avis.titre: Anua Salmon DNA PDRN - Parche de fusión de colágeno.
avis.texte: I liked this product because it is easy to use and leaves the skin well-hydrated and soft.

avis.titre: TikTok Made Me Try It… and I Get the Hype
avis.texte: Title: TikTok Made Me Try It… and I Get the Hype ✨💧 I kept seeing this all over TikTok and finally decided to try it for myself—and honestly, I get why it’s trending. It arrived super fast and in perfect packaging, which is always a great first impression. I haven’t used it long enough to fully speak on long-term results yet, but first impressions are really good. It’s very hydrating and gives my skin that shiny, glowy look right after use. My skin feels refreshed and looks more dewy, which I love. If you’re curious because of the hype, I’d say it’s worth trying—especially if you’re looking for something that gives an instant glow and hydration boost!

avis.titre: Melt fast but not a good effort
avis.texte: I was excited to try this collagen melting patch. Follow the direction, cleaned my face and toned. Place the white part patch on my face, then spray the moisture mist on the patch. It melted fast after I spray on and turn clear. I just removed the net piece after done. I felt my skin is dry and tight after dry, so I followed by my face moisturizer . I didn't notice any improvement of my skin after use. Also I felt a little flaky white thing came off my skin if I scratched my face. Though it seems a good idea and fun to see the patch melt, it didn't work for me.

avis.titre: Parches de colageno para las mejillas
avis.texte: ¡Estos parches de colágeno de Anua para las mejillas son una maravilla! 💖 Desde la primera aplicación sentí mi piel mucho más hidratada, suave y con un efecto relleno súper bonito en la zona de las líneas de expresión.Me encanta cómo se adhieren perfectamente a las mejillas y literalmente se “funden” con la piel, lo que hace que el producto se absorba muchísimo mejor. Después de usarlos, mi piel se ve más firme, luminosa y con ese glow tipo glass skin que tanto me gusta.También noté que mis líneas de sonrisa se ven más difuminadas y la piel se siente más elástica y saludable. Son perfectos para un tratamiento rápido en casa con efecto tipo spa.Definitivamente los volvería a comprar, ¡los recomiendo 100%! ✨

I shouldn’t even give this a star, but unfortunately, I had to. Maybe my order was older or defective. I don’t know, but, it absolutely did not dissolve into my face. I was left with two sheets. One seems like a cotton pad and the other was the mesh pad. Truly disappointing. And, what I am most disappointed about is that I used more of my anua PDRN HYLURAN face spray thinking that would make a difference and it didn’t. I just wasted it, and we all know it’s not cheap.

avis.titre: Glowy skin, sensitive skin, best patch
avis.texte: It’s so convenient because you can simply apply it after your nighttime skincare routine and go straight to bed. Unlike other masks/patches, you don’t have to leave it on and wait. It absorbs into your skin quickly, making it incredibly easy to use. It’s lightweight and not overwhelming like some other packs that require long application times, so I find myself using it every day. Whenever I wear it to sleep, my skin looks noticeably radiant and glowing the next morning.

Reviewing the Anna PDRN Collagen Melting Patches. This is a three pack of small sheet masks. They will cover your cheeks and not much else. They did feel hydrating and calming for the skin. But it’s a lot of time and effort to just moisturize your cheeks. What about the rest of my face? I’d rather have a mask that offers more coverage and treatment for the same amount of effort and time. I could treat my entire face instead of just a small portion of it. In summary-The small size and the price make them not the best value.

The patches look nice and come individually packed, but the first thing I noticed was a strong adhesive like scent. The texture is interesting, yet they didn’t feel as “melting” as the ad suggests. Using them wasn’t as effortless either. You really do need to mist your skin first or they stay stiff and never soften in. They were gentle on my skin and although the effect wasn’t major, they did offer some light hydration.

avis.titre: Innovative and fun to use with excellent ingredients.
avis.texte: My dry aging skin was looking for a treat, so when I saw these Salmon DNA PDRN Collagen Melting Patches from Anua I got excited to try them (IK, get a life right?). They arrive as a 4 pack in a box with security stickers, and each pair of patches are in their own sealed pouch. These patches require a bit of delicate handling with DRY hands, or they will never make it to your face. Basically you spritz toner on your face and apply the patches lining them up next to your mouth and nose. Then, spritz again right onto the patch and watch It miraculously disappear. All that will be left behind is the mesh overlay, which can then be pulled off and discarded. Lastly, just pat the solution gently into the skin. I love these things. They are uniquely fun to use and give instant visible results. After using them, the fine lines around my mouth looked shallower, and my skin overall looked plumper, firmer and more youthful. Now, the plumping effect does not last for days, but these are wonderful to use right before a special occasion for that extra glow. And even though the collagen firming and plumping effect is temporary, the PDRN is offering long term benefits. PDRN is a premium anti aging ingredient for good reason. Research has shown that PDRN has the ability to help cells regenerate quicker. It can also stimulate collagen and elastin production, plus help to support the skin's natural moisture barrier. avis.titre: Collagen patches can be tricky but I like 'em
avis.texte: I felt like these collagen patches left my skin very soft and smooth. I do feel like this type of patch is a more advanced skincare product than a typical sheet mask because placing them can be fiddly thanks to the fact that they start to melt on contact with moisture. Ideally, you will have a facial mist that you can use to moisten the patches after application so that they can melt into your skin. I used the matching ANUA PDRN facial mist, which I also love. This is the second type of collagen patch I have used, and the first one I tried was very similar, but I was quite new to skincare at the time and ended up wasting quite a bit of product because of my difficulty placing the patches without them beginning to melt. Once these touched my face, they were not going to move easily even though my face was relatively dry. They stick well once applied but that has both up and downsides. They will also stick to your fingers if you have any moisture on your hands, so I lost a teeny bit of the edge of one when I was putting them on. Once you get them placed and spritz with a facial mist, you are good to go. They basically disappear, melting into your skin and leaving you silky smooth.

Honestly, I really don’t know too much about the product when I ordered it. But I do know the brand Anua is a well known skincare product. I have used the brand of serum before. Also, the PDRN is a popular ingredient for its regenerative properties. So I was really curious about this PDRN melting patch, especially why it is called melting patch, and the patch can be melted. When I opened the product, I smelled a little bit of alcohol or fermentation on the patches . I do trust the main ingredients of the product, which are 99% collagens with 1% PDRN. The ingredients seems dried up in a thin film, or powder like film, when it was contacted with water, it melted immediately and absorbed by my skin right away , and it created glass smoother skin instantly. Actually I was quite pleased by how it worked out for me. In summary, I believe the product is made of high quality skin care ingredients. It can create an immediate effect on skin tone.

These patches address the cheek area primarily. As someone who smiles a lot and tends to work that area of my face the most, these patches help when I need some extra love in that skin area. The point of these masks are to apply to the skin, spray over the mask with some skincare spray or water, and wait for the mask to dry or ‘almost disappear’ and then remove. It is a mask, so it is recommended to do your usual skincare after the mask routine. The PDRN helps calm any redness and together with the collagen deeply moisturizes my skin on dry, wintery days.

I've loved everything that I've tried from Anua, so it honestly breaks my heart to say that these collagen patches were disappointing. These types of patches are a new concept to me. They are dry mesh/gauze patches that you put on your face and then saturate with mist so that the contents melt onto your skin. The first thing I noticed was that the patches stink. They smell like chemicals. While you don't have to endure the smell for very long, it's off-putting. Not a good start. The first time I tried them, I cleansed my face and then the instructions say to moisten your face with toner or mist, so I misted it with Anua's PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Capsule Mist (which, btw, I love separately). I then applied the patches and misted over them with the same facial mist. Within just a few seconds, the collagen melted off the patch and the patches turned clear, so I removed them. These patches aren’t like face masks where you let them sit for a while. Upon removing them, I could immediately see that the collagen was just sitting on top of my skin. It didn't absorb into my skin and it definitely didn’t leave a glass skin effect. I would call it the opposite. My skin looked tight and dull where the patches had been. I applied a moisturizer over it, so then my skin looked fine, but it didn't look any different from how it normally looks when I apply a moisturizer. The second time I tried them, I applied a moisturizer first instead of just misting my face. Then I applied the patch

I didn’t really get this for wrinkle concerns, but more for hydration. It feels really moisturizing and not sticky, which I like. My skin feels more hydrated and smooth after using it. So far, I’m pretty happy with it.

avis.titre: The patches do dissolve. You have to use the correct layer
avis.texte: To the customer that said they didnt disolve. Id bet you were trying to dissolve the very very very thin protective cover. If the piece you tried kept its shape in anyway, it was the wrong layer.Took me a few mistakes to figure this out. One side will be slightly tacky. Do not try and peel it off. Place the sticky side down on your skin gently press and then peel back yet another protective sheet.i found this worked best. Also, even though it reads clean dry skin, i did lighty, very lightly mist first then placed the patch. This helped the outer cover peel back easier without pulling the thin sheet thats supposed to stay. Then I misted again. If you mist and then let everything soak in for about 10 mins. and if you are very gentle, you can wear makeup. Do not use a makeup brush. Do not rub. A damp makeup sponge and feather light dabs or if you use powder again feather light touch. Those sheer forms in the first photo do not melt. The white side of the blue form is what melts. Place the form with the white side on your skin and the blue side visible. Gently press along the form and gently pull back the edge. Then spray. If the edges of the patch need some extra spray a little on your ring finger and gently press the edge until you cant see the patch
